title: French Chickpea Soup
description: A comforting French-inspired soup made with chickpeas and a blend of creamy and tangy flavors.
instructions: Heat the soup stock in a large pot over medium heat.
Add chopped onion and sauté until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Add chickpeas and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 15-20 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with a sprinkle of paprika or chopped fresh herbs if desired.
